analysis.scope_summary: The Navy requires SWFT fingerprint collection services for personnel requiring background investigations. The contractor must provide electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment at existing locations nationwide. Services include web-based scheduling system, FD-258 card processing, and Electronic Fingerprint Transmissions (EFT) for federal investigation types. The contractor must process up to 900 personnel per year with less than 2% rejection rate.

response.edwosb_value_proposition: Awarding this contract to Dee Davis Inc. directly supports the Department of Defense's Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) utilization goal of 5% as outlined in FAR 19.1505 and the Small Business Act. As an Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business, we contribute to the Navy's socioeconomic objectives while delivering exceptional value and performance. This award demonstrates NSWC IHD's commitment to expanding opportunities for disadvantaged small businesses in the defense industrial base, creating sustainable economic development while meeting critical mission requirements. Our EDWOSB status enables the Navy to report positive small business utilization metrics while receiving superior service delivery and competitive pricing.
response.executive_summary: Dee Davis Inc. understands the critical importance of the Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division's mission to support national security through advanced weapons systems research and development. The integrity of personnel security investigations directly impacts mission readiness and operational security. As an Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), we recognize the Navy's requirement for reliable, compliant SWFT fingerprint collection services that maintain the highest standards of accuracy and security. We are uniquely positioned to deliver comprehensive SWFT fingerprint services through our established network of certified subcontractors and proven contract management capabilities. Our approach ensures seamless electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment, robust web-based scheduling systems, and Electronic Fingerprint Transmissions that consistently exceed the required sub-2% rejection rate standard. We are confident in our ability to provide NSWC IHD with dependable, cost-effective fingerprint services that support your personnel security mission while contributing to the Department of Defense's small business utilization goals.
response.management_approach: Dee Davis Inc. will implement a centralized project management structure with direct CEO oversight ensuring accountability and rapid response to Navy requirements. Our Project Manager will serve as the single point of contact for NSWC IHD, providing weekly status reports, monthly performance metrics, and quarterly business reviews to maintain transparent communication. We will establish a comprehensive communication protocol including 24-hour response times for routine inquiries, immediate notification procedures for any service disruptions, and escalation pathways for urgent requirements. Our management information system will provide real-time visibility into appointment scheduling, processing status, and performance metrics, enabling proactive issue identification and resolution. We will conduct monthly performance reviews with all subcontractor partners, ensuring continuous compliance with SWFT requirements and quality standards. Risk management procedures will include backup facility identification, alternative processing capabilities, and contingency plans for equipment failures or service disruptions. Performance monitoring will encompass monthly rejection rate analysis, customer satisfaction surveys, and continuous process improvement initiatives to exceed Navy expectations.
response.past_performance: Dee Davis Inc. has established a proven track record in contract management and service delivery through our comprehensive approach to subcontractor oversight and performance management. Our experience managing complex service contracts demonstrates our ability to maintain consistent quality standards across geographically distributed operations while ensuring full compliance with federal requirements. We have successfully managed multi-location service contracts requiring strict adherence to federal standards, demonstrating our capability to coordinate diverse service providers while maintaining unified performance standards. Our established relationships with certified service providers enable rapid contract implementation and sustained service delivery. Our zero-defect delivery approach emphasizes proactive quality management, continuous performance monitoring, and immediate corrective action implementation to prevent service disruptions. We maintain detailed performance metrics for all subcontractor relationships, ensuring accountability and enabling data-driven performance improvements that consistently exceed customer expectations.
response.pricing_strategy: Our pricing approach leverages established relationships with certified SWFT service providers to deliver competitive, fair market pricing while maintaining the highest quality standards. We utilize our extensive network of qualified subcontractors to negotiate volume-based pricing advantages that we pass directly to the Navy. Our cost structure eliminates unnecessary overhead while maintaining rigorous quality control and performance management capabilities. We are committed to providing exceptional value through our LPTA approach, ensuring the Navy receives cost-effective fingerprinting services without compromising quality or compliance requirements.
response.quality_assurance: Our quality assurance program implements multi-layered verification processes ensuring consistent compliance with DCSA and OPM standards across all fingerprinting locations. We will conduct monthly quality audits of all subcontractor facilities, verifying SWFT certification maintenance, equipment calibration, and procedural compliance. Our corrective action protocols include immediate notification procedures for quality deficiencies, mandatory retraining requirements, and performance improvement plans for any service providers failing to meet established standards. Real-time performance monitoring will track rejection rates daily, enabling immediate intervention when quality metrics approach threshold limits.
response.staffing_plan: Dee Davis Inc.'s organizational structure positions CEO Dee Davis as the primary Project Manager with direct oversight responsibility for all SWFT fingerprint services. Ms. Davis will maintain daily operational oversight, ensuring compliance with all contractual requirements and serving as the primary interface with NSWC IHD personnel. Our staffing approach leverages proven subcontractor partnerships with certified fingerprinting professionals who possess current SWFT certifications and extensive experience in federal investigation support. We will designate a Contract Administrator responsible for subcontractor coordination, performance monitoring, and quality assurance verification across our nationwide network.
response.technical_approach: Our technical approach centers on leveraging established partnerships with SWFT-certified fingerprinting service providers who maintain active DCSA certifications and operate Live Scan equipment at strategically located facilities nationwide. We will implement a rigorous subcontractor qualification process, ensuring all partners possess current SWFT certifications, maintain compliant Live Scan equipment, and demonstrate proven track records of achieving sub-2% rejection rates. Our network approach guarantees nationwide coverage while maintaining consistent quality standards across all locations. We will establish standardized operating procedures for electronic fingerprint capture, incorporating DCSA requirements and OPM standards to ensure uniform compliance across all service locations. Our quality control methodology includes pre-submission verification protocols, real-time image quality assessment, and immediate retransmission capabilities for any submissions not meeting federal standards. The web-based scheduling system will provide Navy personnel with 24/7 access to appointment booking, real-time availability updates, and automated confirmation processes. We will implement comprehensive tracking capabilities, providing full visibility into submission status, processing timelines, and delivery confirmation to investigating agencies. Our FD-258 card processing procedures will maintain strict chain-of-custody protocols while ensuring rapid transition to electronic format for EFT submission. Performance monitoring will include daily quality metrics tracking, monthly rejection rate analysis, and continuous improvement processes to maintain optimal service levels.
response.understanding_of_requirement: The Navy requires a comprehensive SWFT fingerprint collection capability to support background investigations for up to 900 personnel annually, with processing capacity not exceeding 40 scans per monthly average. This requirement demands active SWFT certification through the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), ensuring compliance with the most current federal standards for electronic fingerprint submissions. The scope encompasses nationwide coverage using existing Live Scan equipment locations, providing convenient access for Navy personnel requiring fingerprinting services across diverse geographic regions. We understand the critical performance standard requiring maintenance of rejection rates below 2% for all electronic fingerprint submissions, demonstrating the Navy's commitment to first-pass accuracy and efficient processing of security clearance investigations. The requirement for FD-258 fingerprint card processing alongside Electronic Fingerprint Transmissions (EFT) indicates the need for flexibility in supporting various federal investigation types and agency preferences. Additionally, the web-based scheduling and tracking system requirement reflects the Navy's emphasis on transparency, accountability, and seamless coordination between personnel, contractors, and investigating agencies.
